name: Kashmir to Ladakh Explorer with Turtuk Experience
route: Srinagar → Kargil → Leh → Nubra Valley → Khardung La → Nubra → Turtuk → Nubra → Pangong Lake → Shyok
description: Embark on a spectacular 7 Nights / 8 Days journey through the mesmerizing landscapes of Kashmir and Ladakh. This carefully designed itinerary blends scenic beauty, cultural richness, and high-altitude adventure. From the serene gardens and lakes of Srinagar to the rugged terrains of Kargil, Nubra Valley, and Pangong Lake, the journey offers a complete Himalayan experience, including a rare visit to the culturally rich border village of Turtuk.
highlights: Shikara ride on the iconic Dal Lake
Visit to Mughal Gardens in Srinagar
Scenic drive through Zoji La Pass
Exploration of Drass – one of the coldest inhabited places
Visit to ancient monasteries like Lamayuru, Hemis & Thiksey
Drive across Khardung La – one of the highest motorable roads
Camel safari in Nubra Valley sand dunes
Excursion to Turtuk village near LOC
Visit to the stunning Pangong Lake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, pick up & Drive to the reserved hotel. Later visit local sightseeing’s like Nishat & Shalimar Garden, in the evening enjoy the beautiful sunset at Dal Lake Shikara Ride at Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Hotel / Houseboat

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Kargil
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast leave for Kargil, via Sonamarg & Zojila pass (3,528 m). Since you are driving across Zojila Pass and its route’s uncertainty, you need to reach Sonamarg early in the morning. Reach Drass Village (2nd Coldest Inhabitant place in the World) by lunch time on the way visit War memorial hall & Museum, reach Kargil by evening loc Kargil Hunderman Boader View Point. Distance 200-210 km approx. Check in at hotel in Kargil

itinerary.title: Kargil to Leh
itinerary.desc: After breakfast departure to Leh on the way visit Mulbekh chamba (Buddha Sculpture on Rock Mountain), Lamayuru (oldest Monastery of Ladakh), Moonland view, Sangam of Sindhu and Zanskar rivers (from view point), Magnetic Hill, Patthar sahib Gurudwara. In evening Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Market. Distance 215-220 km approx. Overnight at Leh

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast, you will set off for Thiksay monastery. Its looks like Potala palace of Tibet, Enroute visit Druk Pama Karpo (Rancho School) Shey Palace. Hemis Monastery (the largest & richest monasteries in Ladakh). In the evening you can visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace (build in 17th century by King Singay Namgyal) after stroll around the market place for some last day souvenir shopping. Distance 120-130 km approx. Overnight in Hotel at Leh

itinerary.title: Nubra to Turtuk (Day Excursion)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast drive towards to Nubra Valley, driving across Khardong-la (Second Highest Motor able Road in the World alt: 5602Mts/18390Ft). After descending from the pass, Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldorma or the valley of flowers. It is situated to the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. Arrive at Hunder & check in at Hotel/Camps. Later visit Diskit Village & the Sand Dunes where you can enjoy a short camel safari using the double-humped Bactrian camel found here (optional on direct payment). Distance 160-180 km approx. Overnight in Hotel/Camp in Nubra Hunder

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake via Shyok
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, leave for Pangong Lake via Shayok. Along the route, enjoy the scenic views of Shayok River & Karakoram Range. This route has few water crossings mainly in the month of June & July, to avoid these you need to leave early from Nubra. Reach Pangong Lake by afternoon. The lake is world highest saltwater lake situated at an elevation of 4,225 m. extending to almost 130 km long, 1/3 of its lies in India and 2/3 in China). NOTE: THIS ROUTE DEPENDS ON WEATHER CONDITIONS. IF ROUTE BLOCK OCCURS REACH BACK TO Leh & STAY OVERNIGH. NEXT DAY Pangong LAKE VISIT WILL BE ONE DAY TRIP. Distance 150-160 km approx. Check in at Camp/hotel in Pangong

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, leave for Leh across another one of the highest motorable roads in the world, Chang La Pass at an elevation of 5360 M –. Enroute visiting Shey Palace, Thiksey Monastery.. Rest & later have a leisure evening in the Leh market. Distance 150-160 km approx. Reach Leh by afternoon/evening, check in at Hotel Leh

itinerary.desc: Concludes.
